description: Department of Elections - Elected Mr. Sandanayaka Mudiyanselage Pemadasa as a member of the Buttala Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Buttala Pradeshiya Sabha) due to an elected member moving to a provincial council. The content specifically deals with electoral procedures under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, including the nomination process by a political party and the official declaration of a new elected member. This falls squarely under election-related matters.
